posts.text: The first post in the sneak-peeks channel: two attachments and no caption.
A short clip of a burning town, seen over a character's shoulder. No caption.
daireb returns after two months: “ok gang it's me, your boy daireb. Sorry for the silence, we've been busy in the kitchen”, then “it's time for some new sneaks”.
“Ok fine… I didn't even want to show you this sneak anyways…”, with a clip.
“How it feels to pull up with a new anime game in 2026...” The clip opens on painted clouds, then lands in a market street where characters stand in a cyan glow.
“do you guys like our sound design”. A fight in a harbour town: fireballs and a long orange slash across the square.
“Can't wait to show you guys what we're cooking up! Big news soon”.
“Are you ready?” A crimson-armoured figure in a hall of blue stained glass, ending on a “coming soon” card. The same day daireb said the server's chat channels would open the following week.
A swordfighter in a walled courtyard with torii gates, trading purple and blue slashes. In announcements: “I wonder if anything will happen TOMORROW... Probably not tho”.
The Discord's chat channels open: “chats are now open”.
A poll, “Release date + trailer tomorrow?”, closes with 96% voting yes.

The release date trailer premieres on YouTube. Afterwards: “Mark the date: Anime Champions X releases on the 26th of November. We'll share gameplay and more details soon :)”. The server's tag changes from ??? to ACX.
A content-creator application form opens, a 10% server XP boost is added for members wearing the ACX tag, and English and Portuguese moderator applications open. They closed on 11 November.
A fly-over of an open map: teal sky, blue grass, giant mushrooms, white pod houses and a view from high above. daireb added: “(runs higher FPS than ACS by the way)”.
“W or L VFX?” An attack that floods a stone courtyard with black ink and briefly turns the whole screen black and white.
